original.one_line: OBLIGATION 4's NUDGE TRIGGER FIRED AND WAS WRONG, FOR THE SECOND MEASURED TIME ON THE SAME SEAT -- and this instance carries the clocks Z-S45 lacked. The L8 packet's receipt read QUEUED with 0 of 1 READ at 23 minutes, which is the literal trigger; at that same moment 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z had 807,769 bytes of ROUND-8 SUPPLEMENT on disk and wrote its ROUND-8 COMPILE seconds into the probe. THE DELIVERY PLANE AND THE PRODUCTION PLANE DISAGREED AND THE PRODUCTION PLANE WAS RIGHT.

evidence: THE TRIGGER, MET ON ITS OWN TERMS: get_delivery_state on message 22183 reads QUEUED, 'no clock stamps yet', READ COVERAGE 0/1 of 1 ackable row, 23 minutes after the packet was handed over at 03:14:45Z. Obligation 4 says no READ ack at one tick -> nudge with path and hash. One tick had passed. The rung was correctly triggered.

AND THE PRODUCTION PLANE SAID THE OPPOSITE, BY NAME AND TO THE SECOND: org/tier1_exec/3.0.0_SA_CVO/deliverables/ carries AMGT_RESAPP_ROUND8_CVO_SUPPLEMENT_20260913_Z.json at 807,769 bytes written 03:32:15Z, amgt_round8_cvo_write_review.py at 03:37:44Z, and AMGT_RESAPP_ROUND8_CVO_COMPILE_20260913_Z.json at 03:37:45Z -- the last two landing DURING this probe. All three name ROUND 8, which is the packet that was allegedly unseen.

CONTROLS ON THE SAME READ, so the timestamps are a measurement rather than a coincidence: NEGATIVE -- a round-9 artifact under the identical naming convention does NOT exist, so the pattern is not matching everything. And the estate-wide commit count since 03:14Z is ZERO, which is why the COMMITS plane reads cold and why a commit-only probe would have convicted a seat that was writing 800 KB.

THE OTHER THREE PLANES AT THAT MOMENT, and every one of them would have supported the nudge: (a) 0 commits by that serial since 02:00Z; (c) no worktree, because A CODEX SEAT HAS NONE and the plane is structurally blind to that whole seat class; (d) .runtime/codex-seats/ carrying only bridge-state.json and startup-prompt.txt once the runtime logs are subtracted. THREE COLD AND ONE BLIND, and the seat was mid-L9.

original.spec_asserts: Obligation 4 of /canonical-drive: an L8 packet at the CVO with no READ ack at one tick is nudged with path and hash; at two ticks it escalates to 0.0.0_AB_MSTR. The rung's clock is the broker's READ state.
original.world_is: THE CLOCK IS KEYED TO AN ARTIFACT THE ADJUDICATOR DOES NOT PRODUCE WHILE WORKING. This seat's adjudicator is a codex seat that acks its inbox at session boundaries rather than at pickup, so its receipt sits at QUEUED for the whole duration of an L9 and flips only afterwards. STAR: THE RUNG THEREFORE FIRES AT PRECISELY THE WRONG MOMENT -- its trigger is most likely to be met exactly while the work is being done, because a seat deep in a compile is a seat not draining its inbox. WARN: AND THIS IS THE SECOND MEASURED INSTANCE ON THE SAME SEAT. Round 7 refused this escalation three times on the same shape; Z-S45 recorded the hazard but carried no timestamps. This one does: receipt QUEUED at 23 minutes against 807 KB of round-8 evidence already on disk.
original.notes: THE DISCRIMINATOR, and it is the rung's own step (b) used in the right order: READ THE DELIVERABLES PLANE BEFORE ACTING ON THE DELIVERY PLANE, and match on the ROUND NAME rather than on recency alone. A file named for the round in question, written after the packet was sent, is positive evidence of pickup that no receipt state can contradict. Cost is one directory listing. WHAT THIS ROW DOES NOT PROPOSE: no change to obligation 4's text, which is not this seat's file, and no claim that the rung is wrong in general -- against a seat whose broker ack is prompt it would be correct and cheap. The narrow claim is that ITS TRIGGER IS NOT EVIDENCE ON ITS OWN, and that firing it here would have interrupted an adjudicator mid-compile for the second time in two rounds. DISARM CONDITION, falsifiable: an obligation-4 decision on this project that prints the deliverables-plane read beside the delivery state in the same sweep, so the receipt can no longer be acted on alone. AND ONE DENOMINATOR THAT MOVED UNDER THIS SEAT DURING THE SAME PROBE, recorded because a carried file count is exactly what this fabric spent the night correcting: the channel domain read 15 files an hour ago and reads 17 now, with 50 of 51 blocks admitted. The adjudicator is opening its round-8 documents as this is written.

cvo_disposition.world_is: The timed evidence corroborates S45: this CVO read exact packet 22183 and produced round-8 evidence while its receipt remained QUEUED. The owner used the deliverables-plane veto successfully, satisfying the stated same-sweep condition. The proposed automatic nudge was not sent. File reading is not broker-client polling; archiving is after the authorized act, and the repository sendguard also rejects a COO ACK. This does not establish that all Codex seats lack worktrees or universally ACK only at session boundaries.
